questions.q: In how many different ways can the letters of the word SCHOOL be arranged?
questions.why: 6 letters with repeats: 6! ÷ 2! = 360. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: A town's population grew from 1,75,000 to 2,62,500 in a decade. What was the average per cent increase per year?
questions.why: Increase 87,500 = 50% over 10 years: 5% a year on average (simple). GPSC CBRT, Sep 2024.

A ladder leaning against a vertical wall makes an angle θ with the ground such that sin θ = 0.8. If the top of the ladder reaches 24 m up the wall, find the horizontal distance from the wall to the foot of the ladder.
questions.why: Ladder = 24 ÷ 0.8 = 30 m; base = √(30² − 24²) = 18 m (3-4-5 triangle). GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.
